name: Battle Glance
description: Perform an area of effect attack with increased damage and attack rating.

subskills.name: Battle Glance
subskills.description: Core of the Battle Glance subtree.

subskills.name: Quick Strike
subskills.description: Increases the amount of attacks performed by battle glance.

subskills.name: Honed Blade
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by battle glance.

subskills.name: Refined Technique
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius of battle glance.

subskills.name: Intanglible
subskills.description: Chance on hit to gain increased dodge chance for a short period.

subskills.name: Execution
subskills.description: Execute monsters with low life.

subskills.name: Restorative Strikes
subskills.description: Leech life and mana on hit.

subskills.name: Spinning Katanas
subskills.description: Chance on attack to summon a rotating blade orbiting around you for a short period inflicting bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: From Behind
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Guided Swing
subskills.description: Increases critical strike damage by battle glance.

subskills.name: Burst of Speed
subskills.description: Chance on kill to gain increased movement speed for a short period.

subskills.name: Shadow From Within
subskills.description: Chance on attack to unleash a shadowy ball of energy traveling towards your blade causing monsters to be cloned to harm them selves on hit.

subskills.name: Blood Harvest
subskills.description: Gain stacks of blood harvest when killing monsters. At maximum stacks gain increased damage and attack speed based on your vitality.

subskills.name: Perfection
subskills.description: Battle Glance now deals increased cleave damage to all monsters within your blade’s reach.

subskills.name: Evasive Prodigy
subskills.description: Dodging or blocking an attack causes your next battle glance to unleash bouncing katanas in an arc infront of you dealing increased damage.

name: Shuriken Throw
description: Throw three piercing Shurikens at your target dealing increased damage.

subskills.name: Shuriken Throw
subskills.description: Core of the Shuriken Throw subtree.

subskills.name: Pointy Edges
subskills.description: Increases critical strike chance.

subskills.name: Quickthrow
subskills.description: Increases projectile speed.

subskills.name: Forceful Flight
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt by shurikens.

subskills.name: Twin Shurikens
subskills.description: Throw additional shurikens with increased mana cost.

subskills.name: Shady Trickster
subskills.description: While standing in smoke bomb thrown shurikens grant you a brief moment of invisibility and increased dodge chance.

subskills.name: Starstruck
subskills.description: Chance on critical strikes to split shurikens into smaller shurikens in a cone behind the target.

subskills.name: Empowering Shurikens
subskills.description: Chance on hit to increase your attack speed and attack damage for a short duration.

subskills.name: Sharp stars
subskills.description: Increases critical strike damage dealt by shurikens.

subskills.name: Throwing Profiency
subskills.description: Increases attack rating while wielding a throwing weapon.

subskills.name: Manainfused Shurikens
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by shurikens according to mana spent.

subskills.name: Shadow Shuriken
subskills.description: Throw a single big shuriken dealing increased damage, stunning and returning to you. If re-casted while shuriken exists, teleport to the shurikens position throwing smaller shurikens in all directions.

subskills.name: Cutting Field
subskills.description: Shurikens now stop mid air and float for a short period and explode into sharp metal shrapnel around it dealing damage and slowing on hit.

subskills.name: Ripping Flesh
subskills.description: Shurikens now attach to monsters on hit and are ripped off back to the samurai after a short period or if the samurai moves far away enough. Shuriken throw now has a cooldown.

subskills.name: Slicing Ricochet
subskills.description: Shurikens now ricochet from monster hits and terrain inflicting bleeding on hit.

name: Quickslash
description: Perform a quick dash unleashing area of effect slash dealing increased physical damage and knocking up monsters.

subskills.name: Quickslash
subskills.description: Core of the Quickslash subtree.

subskills.name: Lightspeed
subskills.description: Increases dash speed.

subskills.name: Greater Slash
subskills.description: Increases quickslash area of effect radius.

subskills.name: Dual Hit
subskills.description: Increases the amount of performed slashes.

subskills.name: Exposed Weakness
subskills.description: Chance on hit to stun the target.

subskills.name: Top to Bottom
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using quickslash.

subskills.name: Exploitation
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Spirit Double
subskills.description: Summon shadow performing quickslash towards a nearby monster dealing a portion of the damage.

subskills.name: Origin Point
subskills.description: Leave a shadow behind slashing monsters around it dealing a portion of the damage.

subskills.name: Lost Teachings
subskills.description: Increases the range of quickslash.

subskills.name: Switch it Up
subskills.description: Quickslash no longer deals damage in a circle and instead deals damage to the closest target and a cone behind them firing multiple piercing kunai.

subskills.name: Plan Ahead
subskills.description: Summon a shadow dashing towards your aim multiple times dealing damage to all monsters hit. After it expires you quickly dash following the same path with massively increased damage.

subskills.name: Multiplicative Duality
subskills.description: Spirit double now spawns multiple shadows dashing with increased speed and damage.

subskills.name: Mechanical Advantage
subskills.description: Dash an increased range sending explosive kunai in an aura at your wake.

subskills.name: Now You See Me
subskills.description: Slash with increased area of effect radius and damage dropping a smoke bomb at target location.

name: Evasion
description: Gain a chance to evade melee and ranged attacks.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Explode a smoke bomb dealing arcane damage.

subskills.name: Smoke Bomb
subskills.description: Core of the Smoke Bomb subtree.

subskills.name: Weakening Powder
subskills.description: Slows and reduces attack rating of targets hit.

subskills.name: Key to Precision
subskills.description: Increases projectile speed.

subskills.name: Acidic Component
subskills.description: Chance on hit to inflict armor break.

subskills.name: Thick Clouds
subskills.description: Increases smoke bomb area of effect radius.

subskills.name: Mindfulness
subskills.description: Inflict arcane break on hit.

subskills.name: Greater Impact
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt by smoke bomb.

subskills.name: Preparation
subskills.description: Smoke bomb has a chance to bounce releasing an additional smoke cloud.

subskills.name: Swift Deploy
subskills.description: Increases cast rate when using smoke bomb.

subskills.name: Feel the Heat
subskills.description: Inflicts burning on hit.

subskills.name: Burning Weakness
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to burning targets.

subskills.name: Adjusted Formula
subskills.description: Significantly reduce enemy attack rating and increase monster damage taken when inside smoke bomb.

subskills.name: Stealth Zone
subskills.description: Throw out smoke bombs in all directions forming a massive cloud increasing your movement speed inside of it. Smoke bomb now has a cooldown.

subskills.name: Monster Cleansing
subskills.description: Smoke bomb consumes damage over time debuffs from monsters inside of it dealing full damage instantly.

subskills.name: Smoke Trail
subskills.description: Smoke bomb now leaves a trail of smoke behind you dealing increased damage. Smoke bomb now has a cooldown.

name: Explosive Kunai
description: Throw an explosive kunai that explodes and splits on impact, causing smaller explosions that deal Arcane damage.

subskills.name: Explosive Kunai
subskills.description: Core of the Explosive Kunai subtree.

subskills.name: Stronger Explosives
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt by explosive kunai.

subskills.name: Packed Up Kunai
subskills.description: Increases kunai explosion area of effect radius.

subskills.name: Satisfaction
subskills.description: Decreases the mana cost of explosive kunai.

subskills.name: Split Up
subskills.description: Chance on hit to split into additional kunais.

subskills.name: Willful Sacrifice
subskills.description: Now consumes a percentage of your maximum life each cast giving your kunai increased speed and explosion aoe. Maximum life damage is non-lethal.

subskills.name: First Is Best
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt and explosion area of effect radius kunai.

subskills.name: Ronin's Curse
subskills.description: Chance to inflict arcane break on hit.

subskills.name: Doubleblast
subskills.description: Chance on hit for the kunai to explode an additional time.

subskills.name: Bouncy Kunai
subskills.description: Kunais have a chance to bounce off of terrain and stun monsters on hit.

subskills.name: Concussive Explosions
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Doubleforking Kunai
subskills.description: Explosive kunai split an additional time dealing increased damage each time they split.

subskills.name: Penetration Volley
subskills.description: Throw a spread of piercing kunai that explode on each enemy hit.

subskills.name: Chainsplosions
subskills.description: Split kunais chain on the first enemy hit exploding on each enemy chained to.

subskills.name: Little Slicers
subskills.description: Explosive kunai no longer explode but instead pierces with increased projectile speed slicing monsters inflicting bleeding.

name: Bushido
description: Activate to gain a buff that increases your attack damage for every 10% of missing Life.

name: Live by the Sword
description: Temporarily increases your attack speed and movement speed.

name: Blade Barrier
description: Summon a barrier of rotating blades around you dealing Physical Damage and additional Arcane Damage.

subskills.name: Blade Barrier
subskills.description: Core of the Blade Barrier subtree.

subskills.name: Rotational Force
subskills.description: Increases blade barriers rotation speed.

subskills.name: Cursed Blades
subskills.description: Blade barrier has a chance to shoot out a blade when hitting a target.

subskills.name: Barrier Extension
subskills.description: Increases duration of blade barrier.

subskills.name: Damascus Steel Blades
subskills.description: Increases physical damage dealt by blade barrier but reduces arcane damage dealt.

subskills.name: Infinite Potential
subskills.description: Increases the amount of blades in the barrier.

subskills.name: Battle Wounds
subskills.description: Chance to cause monsters to bleed on hit.

subskills.name: Crippling Hits
subskills.description: Slows monsters on hit.

subskills.name: Laceration
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding enemies.

subskills.name: Sharp Greeting
subskills.description: Blade barrier deals increased damage to monsters with full life.

subskills.name: Spirit Fire
subskills.description: Physical scaling is converted to burning. Blade barrier now only deals arcane damage.

subskills.name: Twin Barriers
subskills.description: Blade barrier now summons an outer and an inner barrier. The inner barrier deals increased damage and the out barrier is guaranteed to proc cursed blades on hit.

subskills.name: Forgotten Arts
subskills.description: Hitting an enemy refreshes blade barrier duration. Gain increased damage for each active blade barrier you have.

subskills.name: Body And Soul
subskills.description: Blades seek out and stick on nearby monsters dealing increased damage. Blades return to the player if the target is too far away or the monster dies.

subskills.name: Spinning Armory
subskills.description: Adds an additional orbital layer of blades.

name: Exploding Bolas
description: Throw bolas that deal arcane damage on impact and again when they explode after a short delay.

subskills.name: Exploding Bolas
subskills.description: Core of the Exploding Bolas subtree.

subskills.name: Explosive Outburst
subskills.description: Increases the explosion area of effect radius of exploding bolas.

subskills.name: Improved Design
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by exploding bolas.

subskills.name: Close Impact
subskills.description: Inflicts arcane break on hit.

subskills.name: Fastbol
subskills.description: Increases projectile speed.

subskills.name: Multibolas
subskills.description: Throw multiple bolas in an arc.

subskills.name: Low Blow
subskills.description: Bolas have a chance on hit to stun the enemy.

subskills.name: Another One
subskills.description: Chance for bolas to explode an additional time.

subskills.name: Tough Fall
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Speedslinger
subskills.description: Increases cast rate when using exploding bolas.

subskills.name: Longer Ropes
subskills.description: Bolas now pierce allowing them to attach to multiple targets dealing increased damage.

subskills.name: Loaded Charge
subskills.description: Bolas are stuck on enemies for a longer period of time, dealing damage to them during this period causes the explosion to gain increased damage & size up to 5 times.

subskills.name: Clusterducks
subskills.description: Throw multiple explosive rubberducks that bounce towards a nearby target before exploding.

subskills.name: Magnetic String
subskills.description: Monsters caught by bolas are pulled towards the first target.

subskills.name: Bola'd Stasis
subskills.description: Bola now grabs all enemies on its path and pulls nearby enemies towards it when hitting terrain.

name: Fan of Knives
description: Attacks have a chance to throw knives around you dealing physical damage to nearby monsters. Additionally the knives have a chance to ricochet to nearby monsters.

name: For Honor
description: Temporarily increases your attack damage and movement speed.

name: Omnislash
description: Become untargetable and rapidly strike monsters multiple times with increased attack rating dealing increased damage.

subskills.name: Omnislash
subskills.description: Core of the Omnislash subtree.

subskills.name: Clean Hits
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using omnislash.

subskills.name: Extra Cut
subskills.description: Increases the amount of slashes.

subskills.name: No Hesitation
subskills.description: Reduces the cooldown of omnislash.

subskills.name: Powerful Slashes
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by omnislash.

subskills.name: Looming Cover
subskills.description: When cast inside a smoke bomb invulnerability lasts for a small duration after omnislash ends.

subskills.name: Nail In The Coffin
subskills.description: Throw a piercing kunai at a nearby enemy with reduced damage each strike.

subskills.name: Emperor's Orders
subskills.description: Striking monsters with Omnislash has a chance to cast empires slash.

subskills.name: Killstrike
subskills.description: Increases critical chance with omnislash.

subskills.name: Thirst For Death
subskills.description: Chance to increase the amount of slashes depending on your critical strike chance.

subskills.name: Cutting Machine
subskills.description: Increases critical strike damage dealt by omnislash.

subskills.name: Lucky Strikes
subskills.description: Omnislash now always procs all your striking effects on hit with halved amount of slashes and decreased damage. Omnislash cooldown is increased.

subskills.name: Rain Of Chaos
subskills.description: Each slash now drops a shadow meteor down from the sky dealing area of effect damage when landing.

subskills.name: Poison Coated Daggers
subskills.description: Throw poison coated daggers around with each slash inflicting poisoned and dealing increased damage to poisoned targets.

subskills.name: Thunder Slashes
subskills.description: Unleash chain lightning with each slash inflicting lightning break on hit.

name: Burst of Speed
description: Gain increased movement speed for a short period after killing a monster.

name: Shadow Step
description: Step into the shadows, re-appearing at the target location dealing Arcane Damage to all nearby monsters.

subskills.name: Shadow Step
subskills.description: Core of the Shadow Step subtree.

subskills.name: Traversal
subskills.description: Increases teleport distance.

subskills.name: Calm And Collected
subskills.description: Decreases the mana cost of shadow step.

subskills.name: Groundshaker
subskills.description: Chance to stun monsters on hit.

subskills.name: Improved Lethality
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned enemies.

subskills.name: Shadow Ally
subskills.description: Chance on cast to summon shadow clones to mimic your shadow step on a nearby target.

subskills.name: Stepping Stone
subskills.description: Stunning an enemy with shadow step has a chance to increase your damage & cast rate for a short period stacking up to eight times.

subskills.name: Sonic Boom
subskills.description: Chance on cast to deal damage additional times upon arrival.

subskills.name: Crushing Step
subskills.description: Inflict armor break on hit.

subskills.name: Planned Out
subskills.description: Increases cast rate when using shadow step.

subskills.name: Speed Demon
subskills.description: Increases area of effect radius for a portion of your bonus movement speed.

subskills.name: Daggerstorms
subskills.description: Additionally summons a storm of daggers from the sky on hit.

subskills.name: Bargain With Demons
subskills.description: When landing nearby corpses are consumed to unleash a shadow explosion dealing area of effect damage and inflict burning.

subskills.name: Vortex Step
subskills.description: Pull nearby monsters towards you unleashing bolts of shadow energy into all directions when landing dealing additional damage and stunning them.

subskills.name: Pulsating Shadows
subskills.description: Shadow step now pulsates additional times inflicting arcane break.

name: Way of the Warrior
description: Increases your attack damage and magic skill damage.

name: Empires Slash
description: Perform an area of effect attack blinking a short distance and dealing physical damage to monsters in its path. Empire slash lowers Omnislashes cooldown when it strikes a monster.

subskills.name: Empires Slash
subskills.description: Core of the Empires Slash subtree.

subskills.name: Steel Cutter
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by empire´s slash.

subskills.name: Destructive Force
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect of empire´s slash.

subskills.name: Mastering The Sword
subskills.description: Increases the attack speed of empire’s slash when wielding a 2-handed weapon.

subskills.name: On The Mark
subskills.description: Increases the attack rating when using empire´s slash.

subskills.name: Emperor's Command
subskills.description: Executes monsters after a threshold.

subskills.name: Piercing Backslash
subskills.description: Gain additional critical strike damage when using empire’s slash.

subskills.name: Slithering Blade
subskills.description: Gain additional critical strike chance when using empire’s slash.

subskills.name: Absorb Life
subskills.description: Increases life steal when using empire´s slash.

subskills.name: Wounding Slash
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleed on hit.

subskills.name: Time To Spare
subskills.description: Increases the blink range.

subskills.name: Unbridled Rage
subskills.description: Perform a series of slashes in multiple directions after teleporting.

subskills.name: Bloodcovered Edge
subskills.description: Monsters hit by empire´s slash rebound an additional empire´s slash towards a nearby monster. Empire´s slash now has a cooldown.

subskills.name: Cone Of Death
subskills.description: Empire slash no longer teleports and attacks with multiple smaller slashes in a cone infront of you.

subskills.name: Muda Muda Muda Muda Muda
subskills.description: Perform a huge attack covering the whole screen dealing high damage. Empire´s slash no longer teleports you and now has a cooldown.
